snippet.title: JOIN THE CULT! 🦢 Tingus Goose is finally on STEAM! #tingusgoose #idlegames #clickergames
snippet.description:
Get it on: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629780/Tingus_Goose/

Experience the weirdest idle game you'll play this year.
Grow a goose-tree from a patient’s torso, bounce newborn babies for profit, and unlock surreal worlds illustrated by MasterTingus's signature art.
